clips.title: The story
paras: Blackrock orcs hold Stonewatch above the approaches from the Burning Steppes, threatening Lakeshire. The fortress once guarded Redridge against northern invasions.

Stonewatch overlooks the cliffs near Stonewatch Falls, where its tower and keep guard the approaches from the Burning Steppes. Lakeshire's defenders first held the fortress. Then Morganth, a rogue warlock, allied with the Blackrock clan. Dark magic helped the orcs overwhelm the 12th Sabre Regiment and seize the keep. Morganth later turned against his allies and withdrew to the nearby Tower of Ilgalar with an army of Shadowhide gnolls. The Blackrock orcs kept their hold under Warlord Gath'Ilzogg and Lieutenant Tharil'zun.

Blackrock orcs hold Stonewatch, leaving Lakeshire exposed to conquest. Stormwind's House of Nobles has provided no substantial military reinforcements, whether through indifference or paralysis. Magistrate Solomon and Marshal Marris have had to hire mercenaries and call for volunteers. Their best hope of lifting the threat over the region is to strike at the fortress's leaders, Tharil'zun and Gath'Ilzogg.
